title: fix(app-shell): PageView refreshes a page action’s data in place on the invalidation bus instead of remounting the page (objectui#10519)
body:
Fixes #10519
Clause-②: no

Dispatched by the `domain:ui` seat 2 PM, session `session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN` (`mode:subagent`, so that id is also this run's: `https://claude.ai/code/session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`), from claim comment 5855640194 on objectui#10519, executing the unblock 5854561985 and seat decision B 5830213285. Branch `claude/issue-10519-pageview-refresh-in-place`, cut from `origin/main` `b5b6f37531` (BASE); round-1 head `4620ba39d2`. Round 2 (after the contract review 5856227410, FAIL; the ruling 5856239953, readers first; the `Blocked-by` amendment 5857953021) merged `origin/main` `195052fff6` as `25c9aa6d3a` and re-ran the census there. It stopped at the census: see **H1, round 2**. Round 3 (after the seat ruling 5860118207, readers first, and objectui#10853 landing through PR objectui#10873 as `de1b879a6`) merged `origin/main` `1c5ee334a2` as `c5b63fb514`, re-ran the census there with every row green (**H1, round 3**), and carried review items 2 to 4 and the ratchet titles; its head was `42226f9ed1`. Round 4 (after the contract review 5862674975, FAIL; the ruling 5862691924, readers first; objectui#10887 landing through PR objectui#10898 as `9f0c84a44` and PR objectui#10973 as `deca847a8`; seat 2's release 5876662981; and the `domain:ui` seat 1 claim 5877617401, session `session_01DuWo5bdP9SdVebamn99GGk`, `https://claude.ai/code/session_01DuWo5bdP9SdVebamn99GGk`) merged `origin/main` `f6fb83f0c5` as `e021bfaf24`, measured the rows that ruling names on the merged head through a real page action, every one green (**H1, round 4**), pinned four of them in this PR's pin, and carried the changeset and body items. Head `fecce55c33`.

## What changed

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/PageView.tsx`: the `refreshKey` counter is gone, together with the `key` on both render branches (`InterfaceListPage`, ADR-0047 interface mode, and `SchemaRenderer`, the page). The console action runtime's `onRefresh` now points at a module-level `declarePageDataChanged`, which is `notifyDataChanged({ objectName: '*' })` from `@object-ui/react`: a page binds no object and the runtime's refresh carries none, so the bus's documented unknown-scope value is the page's scope. The node `context` handed to `SchemaRenderer` is `{ params }` alone. `useState` is no longer imported. No prop, export or schema key moves.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/PageView.context-9673.test.tsx`: the expected node context is `{ params }` (it was `params` plus `refreshKey: 0`); the header sentence says why.
- `packages/app-shell/src/no-refresh-key-remount.ratchet.test.ts`: the header no longer calls `PageView.onRefresh` a user "Refresh this page" affordance. By a source reading of `useConsoleActionRuntime`, `onRefresh` is fed only by the runtime's post-action refresh (`api`, flow and server-action success, undo, screen-flow completion), and `PageView` has no refresh control. `packages/app-shell/src/views/PageView` joins `IN_SCOPE`. Every other assertion is kept. Its two `it` titles now name the `PageView` page host beside the record-detail surfaces (round 3, titles only).
- New pin `packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/PageView.refreshInPlace-10519.test.tsx` (below). Round 4 adds a describe block for the objectui#10887 readers (**H1, round 4**) and a second object (`account`) to its fixture; the round-1 cases are unchanged.
- `.changeset/10519-pageview-refresh-in-place.md`: `'@object-ui/app-shell': patch`. Round 3: the refresh follows a page-level action "that asks for a refresh"; `PageView`, not the runtime, declares the change; the block list is exactly the set the round-3 census measured green. Round 4: the list adds a `dashboard`'s `optionsFrom` filter options and an `object-view` drawn as a kanban, calendar, gallery or timeline (the rows **H1, round 4** measured green), the dashboard filter's kept value is said beside the form's, and a sentence says what a page action now does to a `kind: 'react'` page: its own read re-runs in place when its effect names the injected `useDataInvalidation` nonce, and a read keyed on `useAdapter` alone is not re-run.
- `.changeset/9673-pageview-drop-context-spread.md` (pending, not in the app-shell `CHANGELOG`): "The node's `context` is now exactly `{ params, refreshKey }`, built from the route and the refresh counter, and the `as any` cast at that spot is gone." becomes "The node's `context` is now built from the route alone, and the `as any` cast at that spot is gone." A plain replacement, not a dated note: the edit can only reach a release together with this PR's code (a release that consumed the entry first would ship the old sentence, true for that release, and turn this edit into a modify/delete conflict), so the replacement is the entry's one release-scoped reading. Frontmatter byte-identical (md5 of lines 1 to 3 `4e8ce55021fe3b14329c8b4cb3f9f354` before and after); `check-changeset-overwrite` reads `@object-ui/app-shell: patch` at base and now. Round 4 rewraps the replaced sentence to the file's width: the words are unchanged (the whitespace-normalised text is identical) and the frontmatter md5 is the same.
- `.changeset/10887-react-page-data-invalidation.md` (pending, from PR objectui#10973, not in the components `CHANGELOG`): "(as `PageView` does after a page action)" becomes "(as `PageView` did after a page action)". This branch stops that remount, and the two entries ship in the same release. A plain replacement, on the `9673` entry's argument. Frontmatter byte-identical (md5 of lines 1 to 3 `3d9e2a1e59bc11924bb99ffd9eea81e3` before and after); `check-changeset-overwrite` reads `@object-ui/components: minor` at base and now. This file is outside the claim's listed surface; see Acceptance notes.

## H1 — premise: the census rows re-read in place on `origin/main`

Runtime census on BASE `b5b6f37531`, through a scratch probe (deleted, never committed): the real `SchemaRenderer`, each plugin's real registration, one counting fake data source per row; reads on mount, then `notifyDataChanged({ objectName: '*' })`, then reads again. A bare `useDataInvalidation` reader beside each block is the positive control, and its nonce moved 0 → 1 in every row. The probe lived under `app-shell` because the root vitest alias map resolves every `@object-ui/plugin-*` specifier to source there; committed, it would trip `check:phantom-deps` (the objectui#10572 PR made the same call).

| block | reads on mount → after the bus event | re-reads in place |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `object-grid` | 1 → 2 | yes |
| `object-chart` (aggregate) | 1 → 2 | yes |
| `detail-view` (findOne) | 1 → 2 | yes |
| `list-view` | 1 → 2 | yes |
| `object-kanban` | 1 → 2 | yes |
| `object-metric` (aggregate) | 1 → 2 | yes |
| `object-form`, default arm (findOne) | 1 → 2 | yes |
| `object-form` `formType: drawer` | 1 → 2 | yes |
| `object-form` `formType: modal` | 1 → 2 | yes |
| `object-form` `formType: split` | 1 → 2 | yes |
| `object-form` `formType: tabbed` | 1 → 2 | yes |
| `object-form` `formType: wizard` | 1 → 2 | yes |
| `object-calendar` | 1 → 2 | yes |
| `object-gallery` | 1 → 2 | yes |
| `object-timeline` | 1 → 2 | yes |
| `object-gantt` | 1 → 2 | yes |
| `element:number` (aggregate) | 1 → 2 | yes |
| `element:repeater` | 1 → 2 | yes |
| `object-map` | not probed here: its committed pin `ObjectMap.invalidationRefetch-10623` mocks `react-map-gl/maplibre`, which does not resolve from app-shell; that pin ran green on BASE in the same lock run (3 cases) | yes |
| `list` (bare key) | n/a | not a data block: `@object-ui/components` owns the bare key as the display list, and plugin-list registers `ListViewRenderer` as `view:list` with `skipFallback: true` so that it never takes that key; `view:list` is the `list-view` row's renderer. |

The studio palette's data category (`BLOCK_TYPE_META`) is `grid`, `object-grid`, `object-form`, `object-metric`, `object-kanban`; every object-bound entry is in the table. Every block in this table, the six `object-form` arms included, re-reads exactly once after the bus event on BASE. What this PR claims covers the census rows only, not every block a stored page can hold: this table; the rows of the round-2 table (`object-tree`, `object-pivot`, `object-data-table`, `report` / `spec-report` over a dataset, `record:line_items` with an authored parent, a `dashboard` dataset table widget), whose readers landed with objectui#10778 and objectui#10814; and the rows round 3 adds, `object-master-detail-form`'s edit-mode detail lines and `element:record_picker`'s options, whose readers landed with objectui#10853. On the merged head `c5b63fb514` every one of them re-reads once in place with no remount (**H1, round 3**). Round 4 adds the rows the ruling 5862691924 names, whose readers landed with objectui#10887: an `object-view` drawn as a kanban, calendar, gallery or timeline, a `dashboard`'s `optionsFrom` filter options, and a `kind: 'react'` page whose effect names the injected `useDataInvalidation` nonce. Each re-reads once in place after a real page action on the merged head (**H1, round 4**).

## H1, round 2 — census on the merged head `25c9aa6d3a`

The round-1 probe, re-run unchanged on its 18 rows, plus the rows the ruling names and one for the `dashboard` block, whose dataset widgets read on a page since objectui#10815. Scratch probes again, never committed, archived in the seat scratchpad (`issue-10519/census-10519-r2.probe.test.tsx.archived`, md5 `ba70dc05bf7a266d6a7535c9c7990b2e`; `issue-10519/census-10519-r2-md.probe.test.tsx.archived`, md5 `2d830df32bf6975b2be2edc5cb2050ef`). New this round, a remount witness: the row's own registry entry (`ComponentRegistry.get`, which `SchemaRenderer` resolves the node through) is wrapped in a counter whose dependency-free mount effect runs once per instance and whose cleanup runs once per unmount. Witness control: `object-metric` under a host re-keyed on the bus nonce, the shape of the removed `key={refreshKey}`, reads `1 → 2` like an in-place re-read, and the witness reads mounts `1 → 2`, unmounts `+1`. So the read count alone cannot tell the two apart, and the witness can. Run under the verify lock, `Tests 29 passed (29)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0` (26 probe cases, the three `ObjectMap.invalidationRefetch-10623` cases).

| block | reads on mount → after the bus event | mounts at the event → after · unmounts | re-reads in place, no remount |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| the 18 round-1 rows (`object-grid`, `object-chart`, `detail-view`, `list-view`, `object-kanban`, `object-metric`, `object-form` default / drawer / modal / split / tabbed / wizard, `object-calendar`, `object-gallery`, `object-timeline`, `object-gantt`, `element:number`, `element:repeater`) | 1 → 2 each | 1 → 1 · +0 each | yes |
| `object-tree` | 1 → 2 | 1 → 1 · +0 | yes |
| `object-pivot` | 1 → 2 | 1 → 1 · +0 | yes |
| `object-data-table` | 1 → 2 | 1 → 1 · +0 | yes |
| `report` over a dataset (`queryDataset`) | 1 → 2 | 1 → 1 · +0 | yes |
| `spec-report` over a dataset (`queryDataset`) | 1 → 2 | 1 → 1 · +0 | yes |
| `record:line_items` with an authored `parentId` | 1 → 2 | 1 → 1 · +0 | yes |
| `dashboard`, a dataset table widget (`queryDataset`) | 1 → 2 | 1 → 1 · +0 | yes |
| `object-map` | its committed pin `ObjectMap.invalidationRefetch-10623`, same run: one re-read after `'*'`, the map node unchanged (3 cases) | n/a | yes |
| witness control: `object-metric` under a host re-keyed on the nonce | 1 → 2 | 1 → 2 · +1 | by remount only |

**Two blocks a stored page can hold do not re-read. This is the stop condition 5854561985, and round 2 stopped here.**

| block, as a stored page holds it | reads on mount → after the bus event | mounts · unmounts | re-reads in place |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `object-master-detail-form`, `mode: 'edit'`, authored `recordId`: the header (`findOne` of the parent) | 1 → 2 | 1 → 1 · +0 | yes |
| the same block: its detail lines (`find` of the child object) | 2 → 2 | 1 → 1 · +0 | **no** |
| the same block under a host re-keyed on the nonce: its detail lines | 2 → 4 | 1 → 2 | by remount only |
| `element:record_picker`: its options (`find` of its object) | 1 → 1 | 1 → 1 · +0 | **no** |

- **A stored page can hold both.** Both are `ComponentPropsMap` keys in `@objectstack/spec` 17.4.0, the installed version. `PageSchema.safeParse` accepts a page holding `object-master-detail-form` with `mode: 'edit'`, `recordId` and `details`, and `ComponentPropsMap['object-master-detail-form']` parses those properties. objectui registers both: `object-master-detail-form` in `plugin-form`, which the console's `register-plugins.ts` imports eagerly, and `record_picker` in `components`. Both read through the page's adapter (`SchemaRendererContext`, `useAdapter()`).
- **Source reading (context, not the measurement).** `MasterDetailForm`'s edit-mode children effect keys on `isEdit`, `dataSource`, `schema.recordId` and `resolvedEntries`. The picker's option effect keys on `adapter`, `object`, `filterKey`, `sortKey` and `limit`. Neither names a bus nonce, so after a page action nothing re-runs them, and before this PR the remount did.
- **Recorded, not gating.** `object-form` with `subforms` routes to the same `MasterDetailForm` and measured the same (lines 2 → 2). But `ComponentPropsMap['object-form']` refuses `subforms` by name (`unrecognized_keys`), so a spec-valid page does not hold that route.
- **Resolved in round 3.** objectui#10853 (PR objectui#10873, `de1b879a6`) gave both blocks a bus reader, and round 3 measures them green below. Review items 2 to 4 and the ratchet `it` titles are on the branch.

The detail lines read twice on mount, as objectui#10853 measured at its BASE (the load effect runs again once the resolved details are set); the bus event adds exactly one read.

**Unsaved lines are held, then re-read once after a revert or a save** (objectui#10853's rule, measured through the same block, one bus event each):

| case | line reads at the event → while dirty → after | mounts · unmounts | lines on screen while held |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| type into the first line, `'*'`, then type the stored value back (revert) | 2 → 2 → 3 | 1 → 1 · +0 | `["first edited"]` |
| type into the first line, `'*'`, then the form's save (`batchTransaction` once) | 2 → 2 → 3 | 1 → 1 · +0 | n/a |

No block a stored page can hold, among the census rows, still refreshes only through the remount. The stop condition 5854561985 does not hold this round.

## H1, round 4 — census on the merged head, through a real page action

The ruling 5862691924 names three rows: `object-view` (kanban, plus at least one of calendar, gallery, timeline, map or tree), a `dashboard` with an `optionsFrom` filter, and a `kind: 'react'` page, since objectui#10887 member 3 injected `useDataInvalidation`. This round measures them through the real `PageView` and one real page action each, not through a bare bus event. Each row is a stored page in the spec shape (`regions`, blocks as `{ type, properties }`) holding the page's `api` action (`target: /api/v1/environments`, run through the console runtime's `apiHandler`, so no `onMutation` fires), a stand-in with an instance id, and the block. The probe counts the block's reads of the object it queries on a counting fake data source. It wraps the block's own registry entry (`ComponentRegistry.get`, which `SchemaRenderer` resolves the node through) in a mount and unmount witness, and it reads state a remount resets. Scratch probe, never committed: `census-10519-r4.probe.test.tsx`, archived in the round-4 scratchpad (md5 `af5ede3a47187d8a201e3df4548b6499`). At head `fecce55c33`, under the verify lock: `Tests 8 passed (8)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`. The probe writes each row to a file; it asserts nothing about the counts.

| row | reads of its object, at the action → after | witness: mounts · unmounts | page stand-in | state a remount resets | pinned in this PR |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `object-view`, `defaultViewType: 'kanban'` | 1 → 2 | 1 → 1 · +0 | 1 → 1 | the `Deal 1` card is the same node | yes |
| `object-view`, calendar (a named view with `calendar.startDateField`) | 1 → 2 | 1 → 1 · +0 | 1 → 1 | the navigated month (October 2026) is kept | yes |
| `object-view`, `defaultViewType: 'gallery'` | 1 → 2 | 1 → 1 · +0 | 1 → 1 | the `Deal 1` card is the same node | yes |
| `object-view`, timeline (a named view with `timeline.startDateField`) | 1 → 2 | 1 → 1 · +0 | 1 → 1 | the `Deal 1` item is the same node | no, probe only |
| `dashboard`, a `globalFilters` select with `optionsFrom` (the `find` fallback read) | 1 → 2 | 1 → 1 · +0 | 1 → 1 | the selected `retail` is kept; the trigger is the same node | yes |
| the same filter, the dataset read (`queryDataset`) | 1 → 2 | 1 → 1 · +0 | 1 → 1 | as above | no, probe only |
| `kind: 'react'` page whose effect names `useDataInvalidation('project')`; the action is a `Block` of type `action:button` inside the page | 1 → 2 | the page's `app` entry 1 → 1 · +0; the author's own mount effect 1 → 1 | n/a (the page is the block) | the counter clicked before the action still reads 1; the button is the same node | no, probe only |
| control: the same react page, its read keyed on `[adapter]` alone | 1 → 1 | 1 → 1 · +0; author mounts 1 → 1 | n/a | the counter is kept | no |

- **No row re-reads only through the remount.** No new remount-only reader was found, so "readers first" does not stop this round.
- **The remount key.** `PageView` carries no `key` on either branch (the `no-refresh-key-remount` ratchet holds the file), and the witness saw no remount at or below each block's registry entry.
- **The calendar row.** Its region node is not the same node after the action. While the view re-reads, `ObjectView` hands the calendar `loading`, and `ObjectCalendar` shows its loading placeholder in place of the grid, as PR objectui#10973's note (c) records. `ObjectCalendar` itself is not remounted: the witness reads 1 → 1, and the month it holds in its own state is kept. In the legs where nothing re-reads (A2, R3 below), the region node is the same, so the swap follows the re-read.
- **What is pinned.** The round-4 describe block of `PageView.refreshInPlace-10519` holds four rows: the kanban, gallery and calendar `object-view`s, and the dashboard filter over the `find` read. Each asserts both halves: (a) the stand-in's instance id, plus the card node, the navigated month, or the filter's trigger node and selected value; (b) exactly one re-read of the block's object. Timeline, the dataset read and the react page stay probe-only. `@object-ui/app-shell` declares neither `@object-ui/plugin-timeline` nor `@object-ui/react-runtime`, and neither does the workspace root, which is what `check:phantom-deps` asks of a test import. A react page also loads its runtime with a dynamic `import()`, which a committed test would race inside a bounded wait (AGENTS.md, flaky-test discipline). Their readers' own pins fail on the round-3 code path: `ObjectView.busReread-10887` covers the timeline, `DashboardFilterBar.busReread-10887` covers both reads, and `react-page-invalidation` covers the react page scope (its base leg is a `ReferenceError`, per PR objectui#10973).

Legs, each on committed state (`beac974876`; the commit after it changes changesets only), with the probe's first seven cases (the adapter-only control came after) and the pin. `PageView.tsx` and the three readers resolve to `src` (the relative import, and the root vitest alias for `@object-ui/plugin-view`, `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` and `@object-ui/components`), so no `dist/` preflight applies. Every restore is by blob hash against `HEAD`, with `git diff HEAD` empty.

| leg | mutation (on-disk proof) | probe | pin |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| A1, the pre-fix host | `PageView.tsx` = `main`'s blob `1ace6962da` (HEAD blob `979bb11eb7`; two `key={refreshKey}` sites) | every row: mounts 1 → 2, unmounts +1, stand-in 1 → 2, the node replaced; the month reset to September 2026, the filter back to `Industry: All`, the react counter back to 0 and the author's mount effect 1 → 2 | `Tests 6 failed \| 8 passed (14)` over probe and pin: all six in-place cases red on (a); the lit control green |
| A2, the host declares nothing | `ablation-replace`: anchor `notifyDataChanged({ objectName: '*' });` 1 → 0, blob `979bb11eb7` → `7bb3888fd2` | every row: reads 1 → 1, no remount | `Tests 6 failed \| 8 passed (14)`: the same six red on (b) (metric, list, kanban, gallery, calendar, dashboard); the lit control green |
| R3, `ObjectView` on the round-3 path | `ablation-replace`: the `invalidationNonce` entry deleted from the non-grid fetch's dependency list (1 → 0), blob `db64424727` → `90e198e990` | the four `object-view` rows: reads 1 → 1, no remount; the others unchanged | `Tests 3 failed \| 11 passed (14)`: kanban, gallery and calendar red on (b) |
| R3, `SelectFilter` on the round-3 path | `ablation-replace`: `, dataSource, invalidationNonce]);` → `, dataSource]);` (1 → 0), blob `9d93a32b56` → `b636341b96` | both dashboard rows: reads 1 → 1, the value kept | `Tests 1 failed \| 13 passed (14)`: the dashboard case red on (b) |
| R3, the react page scope on the round-3 path | `react-page.tsx` = its `42226f9ed1` blob `f70b8f4251` (HEAD blob `ab712dface`) | the react row fails at render: `ReferenceError: useDataInvalidation is not defined` in the page's error panel | not in the pin |
| R3', the hook injected but never moving | `ablation-replace`: `useDataInvalidation,` in the scope becomes a function that always returns 0 (1 → 0), blob `ab712dface` → `ade9a50713` | the react row: reads 1 → 1, no remount | not in the pin |
